title: Taiwanese American Council of Greater New York 大紐約區台灣人社團聯合會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Council of Greater New York (TAC-GNY) is an umbrella organization coordinating Taiwanese American organizations and clubs in the Greater New York area. It promotes Taiwanese culture and heritage, and educates the broader community about Taiwanese American history. TAC-GNY serves as a coordinating apparatus to promote the well-being and betterment of the Taiwanese American community in the region.
